'''September 2001 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, NY on 29 September 2001. [[Matt Ehrhart]] won it. It is known from Matt Ehrhart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3005">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-30-wiliston-park-ny-9-29-01d3005/ wiliston-park-ny-9-29-01], DeckTech (Matt "TmastamattC" Ehrhart, 30 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-30-wiliston-park-ny-9-29-01d3005/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]
